cluster: pulse: public holidays, school holidays, bridge days and long weekends by country, subdivision, year and month
how_it_was_found: not by guessing a new family. An offline audit of the 91 catalogue families found 57 producing zero pages, and 29 of those lost all 124,202 of their generated rows to one cause: fewer than two declared source fields in the required_data column of FAMILY-MASTER.csv. Nine of the 29 carry source_state HELD, meaning the data is already on disk. The pulse group is the largest of them.
method: keywords-explorer-matching-terms, match_mode phrase, one call per language on the native term, ordered by volume descending with a volume floor, so the TAIL is sampled rather than one head keyword extrapolated. Then serp-overview on two German keywords.
the_axis_the_demand_actually_has: country x SUBDIVISION x year, plus country x month x year. This is not a city family and not a country family. Every strong market splits by its own administrative subdivision: German Bundeslaender, Polish voivodeships, Spanish comunidades, French school zones, Dutch regions, British nations and counties, Brazilian states.

fr-FR.verdict: ADMIT. The largest family measured anywhere in this project.

pt-BR.verdict: ADMIT. The month axis is stronger here than anywhere else.

en-GB.verdict: ADMIT. Four nations plus a county tail.

pl-PL.verdict: ADMIT. All sixteen voivodeships carry measurable demand, which is the cleanest subdivision axis of any market.

de-DE.verdict: ADMIT. All sixteen states on three separate topics, plus a measured foreign-country axis from the German market, plus the highest CPC band of any language.

nl-NL.verdict: ADMIT. The best commercial signal in the cluster: CPC 25 to 200 cents on the school holiday axis.

es-ES.verdict: ADMIT. Nineteen subdivisions and provinces above 1,700 a month.
es-ES.noise_excluded: mercadona horarios apertura festivos 6,100 and apertura festivos carrefour 4,800 at CPC 300 to 800 cents are SHOP OPENING HOURS, a retail intent this project has no source for and no business answering. They are excluded, not counted.

it-IT.verdict: REFUSE this phrasing and admit only the country level. The Italian term for a bridge day, ponti, collides with the surname: Carlo Ponti 11,000, Edoardo Ponti 13,000, Gio Ponti 7,900, i ponti di madison county 7,100. Of the sixty rows returned only ponti 2026 at 20,000, giorni festivi 2026 at 5,900 and vacanze scolastiche 2026 at 1,900 belong to this intent. Measuring the term rather than assuming it is what caught this.

en-US.verdict: WEAK. The American term is federal holidays and bank holidays reads 16,000 against 415,000 in the United Kingdom. The United States axis needs its own measurement on the right term before anything is admitted.
en-US.noise_excluded: chase bank holidays 500 at CPC 1,500 cents and chime bank holidays 1,100 are branded banking-hours queries, not public holiday queries.

the_data_is_already_on_disk.providers: OpenHolidays, Nager.Date, GOV.UK, Cabinet Office of Japan, TaiwanCalendar mirroring the Executive Yuan
the_data_is_already_on_disk.localisation_is_in_the_SOURCE: each holiday record carries a names object keyed by language, so a German page uses the official German name and a Polish page the official Polish one. This is the one family measured in this project where the localisation is not a translation at all, which is why it cannot fail the TRANSLATION_ONLY gate the way the destination POI fan-out did.
the_data_is_already_on_disk.the_binding_limitation: the window is only [2026, 2027]. Demand is measured for 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026 and 2027: vacances scolaires 2025 reads 477,000, feiertage nrw 2025 reads 56,000, feriados 2024 reads 81,000, bank holidays 2025 reads 80,000. The year is a fetch parameter on every one of these APIs, not a data limit, so widening the window to 2024 to 2028 multiplies the year axis by about 2.5 at no quality cost.
the_data_is_already_on_disk.a_defect_found_in_the_store: the language keys in the names objects are inconsistently cased: en appears 116 times and EN 98 times, IT 110, DE 102, and a literal key local 100 times. A page lookup keyed on a lowercase language code finds the German name for some holidays and nothing for others. This is the same class of normalisation defect as the Polish diacritics and the cuisine token case, and it has to be fixed before the family is generated.

why_this_is_in_scope_and_not_a_contrivan: events.city-calendar already holds 6,680 pages built on this same store, so the surface exists. The intent is travel planning: a German searching Brueckentage is deciding when to take a trip, which is why Dortmund Airport, TUI Cars, Sparkasse and the DGB all rank for it. A page that gives the official dated list for a named subdivision, the long weekends it creates, the bridge days that extend them and the maximum days off a plan can reach is a real answer, and bridge_plans already computes exactly that with a max_days_off field.
licence_and_provenance: Ahrefs Keywords Explorer matching-terms and SERP overview via the Ahrefs API v3 on 2026-10-07. Nine language calls and two SERP samples, 7,492 units. Holiday data from data/atlas/sources/events/ under the licences recorded in each provenance block.
